description: Bring an EXISTING app to Dropyour in one call: zip its files (you have them — from GitHub, disk, another host) and pass the archive. A single-HTML archive publishes like dropyour_publish, any tier, no account. A multi-file archive publishes the entry HTML, then graduates to tier 4 and uploads every file IF the owner's plan has a free server app (like dropyour_graduate); it requires an account token. Without one, the entry HTML is live and the response says what is missing. If a step is refused midway, the response says exactly what was created and what to do next; nothing is hidden. The entry file is index.html at the archive root (or the single/shallowest .html). COST: every byte of zipBase64 is written in your message. If you can run a command and the archive is more than a few kilobytes, import a small page here (or with dropyour_publish), then send the real archive from the disk with dropyour_upload action:'url'.

expiresInSeconds.description: Expiration in seconds (1h..2592000); default: your tier's default

name.description: A private name for this drop (only you see it). Default: the HTML <title>.

zipBase64.description: The app's files as a .zip archive, base64-encoded. index.html at the root is the entry.

name: dropyour_import
title: Import an existing app
